required_tokens: current quote timestamp;accepted C-code;no automatic substitution;order archive
closure_criteria: JLCPCB quote evidence confirms BOM/POS acceptance and every locked C-code or records reviewed substitutions before spending order money.
Production passive release evidence records pulse surge current derating and measured board temperature at the accepted duty cycle.
First power evidence records bench supply settings polarity VIN24 current limit RJ45 power disabled state and no hot-plug boundary.
Buck bring-up evidence records U15 U16 startup overshoot ripple load-step behavior and hot component temperatures.
Production input release evidence defines fuse or current limit reverse-polarity strategy TVS/transient strategy and RJ45 harness limits.
Laser bring-up evidence records measured current optical power driver or sense temperature and shutoff behavior for LD1 through LD4.
Laser safety evidence records wavelength-rated eyewear enclosed beam stop one-channel-at-a-time procedure and received-can pinout inspection.
AP2112 evidence records no-RF firmware state plus measured +3V3 current and AP2112 package temperature.
Production regulator evidence either keeps RF disabled or records measured duty-cycle thermal proof or a regulator replacement decision.
AD7606 timing evidence records scoped RESET CONVST BUSY CS and SCLK behavior with BUSY fall before CS.
AD7606 readback evidence records both DOUT lanes with 32 SCLK edges per sample and firmware sample logs.
AD7606 system evidence records range and oversampling metadata channel order for VOUT1 through VOUT4 and known-input count accuracy.
Signal-PD evidence records RF VBIAS dark counts slope saturation and noise floor for D1 through D4.
Signal-PD release evidence records ambient or shielding condition and firmware saturation or out-of-range behavior.
Monitor-PD evidence records LD1 through LD3 dark counts slope optical power and firmware fail-shutoff behavior.
Monitor-PD evidence records LD4 MPD4 as spare/open and proves firmware does not use MPD4 for blue APC or safety telemetry.
